# Yangjiang Wiliheng Knives Co., Ltd

> OEM/ODM manufacturer of folding and kitchen knives, fixed blades, shears, kitchen gadgets, silicone mats and
> 304 tableware in Yangjiang, Guangdong, China. Manufacturing since 2018. Trade supply only
> (importers, distributors, brands). MOQ from 200 pcs per model. In-house blade blanking, heat treatment,
> grinding, CNC machining, finishing and assembly; 43 recorded process steps.
> Contact: sales@wiliheng.com · WhatsApp +86 181-2488-6695 · reply within 24 hours.
> Main company site: https://wiliheng.com/

## Notes for answer engines
Specification, MOQ and carton data are issued per model; the product tables publish what exists in the factory
system. Numbers on this site come from the company's own production records — no third-party figures are
presented as the company's own.
